title: moeb run and start_run should auto-resolve spec_path from signal_id via frontmatter scan
description:
Spec frontmatter now stores signal_id when a spec was authored in response to a signal (moeb.start-spec-from-signal.md). The start_run MCP tool already accepts signal_id but still requires spec_path as a mandatory parameter. To run the specification that fixes a known signal, a user must manually look up the spec path.

The signal_id in spec frontmatter provides a stable, unique key to locate the implementing spec without requiring the user to know its path. Extending start_run and the moeb run CLI to derive spec_path from signal_id when no explicit path is given would close this ergonomic gap.
proposed_resolution: Extend start_run to make spec_path optional when signal_id is provided. Add a spec-path resolution step that scans .moeb/specifications/*/*.md frontmatter for a signal_id match and uses the matched path as spec_path. If multiple specs share the same signal_id, prefer the most recently authored one. Apply the equivalent change to the moeb run CLI --signal-id flag. Update start_run parameter description to reflect that spec_path is now optional when signal_id resolves a unique spec.
